first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Adult male appearance, with short light-brown hair, wearing a black coat with a visible white cuff and shirt collar, ascending along the passage beside the wooden post.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: Grayish-brown brick-and-stone wall surface in the passage, with a rough surface partially covered by light-colored plaster.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: Thick dark-brown wooden post in the foreground and partially visible connected components, with protruding dark fasteners on the middle and lower portions of the post.

entities.name: Light-colored inclined surface by the window
entities.identification: Light grayish-brown inclined surface area adjoining the lower edge of the opening at the bottom of the window opening; its scope is limited to the currently visible area, without distinguishing between a windowsill and an exterior roof surface.

entities.name: Group of reddish-brown tubular components
entities.identification: Several reddish-brown elongated tubular components arranged side by side outside the window opening on the right in the early portion.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: The set of visible openings in the brick-and-stone wall, with thick light-colored window edges, inner walls, and lower edges, excluding the components outside the windows and the distant view.

entities.name: Green vegetation outside the window
entities.identification: A blurry green band-shaped area in the distant view outside the window opening on the left.
